gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-otto: Lemon Milk spreads out wide and loose, every letter traced like a rolling-ball pen line you could follow with a finger. Noto Serif Ottoman Siyaq is the dignified one here, a classic serif whose bowls swell only slightly and whose crossbars run a touch thinner than its stems.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-sinh: Lemon Milk is friendly and striking, with rounded, open letters framed by strokes of one width throughout. Noto Serif Sinhala handles the refined, bookish side, its tall band of letters showing a faint nib-pressure shift across each curve.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-telu: Wide, loose and rounded, with a pen-trail look! Noto Serif Telugu takes over as the traditional text serif, its thick strokes only slightly heavier than thin ones and its lowercase rising nearly to the capitals.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-thai: Wide-spaced, rounded and unshaded, this heading looks drawn in a single pass. Noto Serif Thai then settles in below with moderate contrast and big bodies that dominate the line, so the page moves from playful to authoritative.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-tibe: Lemon Milk is all loose tracking and rounded letters drawn with one gentle, steady line thickness, friendly and striking at once. And Noto Serif Tibetan answers with a literary serif whose tall x-height and softly thinning joins give the text a quiet authority.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-todh: Classic and traditional, this serif has a sizable x-height and curves whose thinnest points still carry real weight. Noto Serif Todhri can be given generous size on screen, while Lemon Milk's stencil-cut, single-weight strokes stay in the heading.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-toto: Wide-set and pipe-cleaner bent, friendly yet striking, Lemon Milk looks like it was drawn in one confident, uniform line. Noto Serif Toto is a classic serif with hulking, chalky lowercase, and its gentle thick-thin shifts keep reading comfortable.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-vith: Big round lowercase bowls and low-key thick-thin variation give this serif an editorial, classic feel. Noto Serif Vithkuqi handles the reading, while Lemon Milk's wide, rounded letters have no hairlines to squint at.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noto-serif-yezi: Words here read as solid blocks rather than skylines, with robust downstrokes and slender turns in a classic text serif. Noto Serif Yezidi likes a generous size, and Lemon Milk's single-thickness counters hold the heading.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-pt-serif-captio: Lemon Milk spreads its rounded letters wide, each one looking drawn with a single nib, friendly and striking. PT Serif Caption is the literary text serif, with a tall x-height and a quiet shift in line weight like brushed watercolor.
